"""Counts for the revised W2-86 case: compared paths, and how many excluded paths moved (names not printed)."""
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-91-tests/tests/acceptance/W2-86")
import test_w2_86_kernel_template_embedding as t  # noqa: E402

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    tmp = Path(folder)
    base = tmp / "base"
    (base / t.PROJECT_DIR).mkdir(parents=True)
    text = t.subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"{t.BASE}:{t.PATH_MAP}"], cwd=t.ROOT, check=True,
                            capture_output=True).stdout
    (base / t.PATH_MAP).write_bytes(text)
    every = t._tracked(inside=False)
    kept = [rel for rel in every if not t._newly_embedded_by_dec_957(rel)]
    left = [rel for rel in every if t._newly_embedded_by_dec_957(rel)]
    for name in ("h", "b"):
        (tmp / name).mkdir()
    moved = t._selected(t.ROOT, every, tmp / "h") ^ t._selected(base, every, tmp / "b")
    print("outside template:", len(every), "compared:", len(kept), "left out:", len(left))
    print("moved overall:", len(moved), "moved among compared:", len(set(moved) & set(kept)))
    tops = sorted({rel.split("/")[0] for rel in kept if "/" in rel})
    print("compared top-level folders:", tops)
